def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, np.inf)
    feasible = bins >= item
    if np.any(feasible):
        # Among feasible bins, priority = remaining capacity after insertion
        priority_scores[feasible] = bins[feasible] - item
    return priority_scores

algorithm: {We compute priority as the remaining capacity after adding the item, preferring bins that are nearly full but still fit the item, by taking the negative absolute difference between the bin capacity and the item size, then adjusting so that bins that cannot fit the item get the lowest priority.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    priority_scores[valid] = -np.abs(bins[valid] - item)
    return priority_scores
